Activity Status.description: The status of an activity - one of an enumerated set of values.

Actors.description: Actors or Solution Roles related to this element.

Additional Properties.description: Additional Properties  allow arbitrary properties not defined in the type definitions to be added to any referenceable element.

Agreement End Date.description: Date when the agreement expires or was terminated, in ISO 8601 format.

Agreement Name.description: The name of the agreement to add an item to. Using qualified names is recommended.

Agreement Start Date.description: Date when the agreement becomes effective, in ISO 8601 format.

Aliases.description: Alternative names for this  field, used in different systems or contexts.

Anchor Scope IDs.description: A list of IDs that are anchor scopes for this element.

Benefits.description: The positive outcomes from using this pattern.

Category.description: A user-defined category for the element, used to group related elements for display or search purposes.

Certification Type.description: The certification type being used for the certification.

Class Word Classification.description: Classification from 0438. Applied to Referenceable. Marker classification (no attributes) indicating the element is a class word in a naming standard.

Collection Id.description: The unique identifier (qualified name or GUID) of the collection.

Confidence.description: A percent confidence in the proposed adding of the member.

Confidence Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses ConfidenceLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, AD_HOC=1, TRANSACTIONAL=2, AUTHORITATIVE=3, DERIVED=4, OBSOLETE=5, OTHER=99.

Confidentiality Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses ConfidentialityLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, INTERNAL=1, CONFIDENTIAL=2, SENSITIVE=3, RESTRICTED=4, OTHER=99.

Content Status.description: The lifecycle status of an element.

Context.description: Description of the situation where this pattern may be useful.

Created Time.description: The time at which an element  was created.

Criticality Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses CriticalityLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, MARGINAL=1, IMPORTANT=2, CRITICAL=3, CATASTROPHIC=4, OTHER=99.

Display Name.description: The common name of an element.

Document Identifier.description: A user supplied identifier for the governance document.

Due Time.description: Due date/time for a Meeting, ToDo, or Review person action.

Effective From.description: The beginning of when an element is viewable.

Effective Time.description: The time at which an element must be effective in order to be returned by the request.

Effective To.description: The ending time at which an element is visible.

Element Id.description: The unique identifier (qualified name or GUID) of the element being referenced.

Element2 Id.description: The unique identifier (qualified name or GUID) of a second element being referenced.

Entitlements.examples: Allowed to use within the organization.
Entitlements.description: A dictionary of property:value pairs describing entitlements.

Expression.description: An expression describing a membership, relationship or classification.

Extended Properties.description: A dictionary of properties that extend the properties of an entity type.

External Source GUID.description: The unique identifier of an external source.

External Source Name.description: The name of an external source

File Path.description: Path to the file including file name. File system name is pre-pended if set.

File System Name.description: Optional  file system name to be prepended in front of the path name.

For Duplicate Processing.description: Flag indicating if the request is to support duplicate processing.

For Lineage.description: Flag indicating if the request is to support lineage.

Forces.description: Description of the aspects of the situation that make the problem hard to solve.

Glossary Term.description: Term that provides meaning to this field.

GUID.description: A unique identifier - typically of an element in this context.

Impact Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, severity_identifier: int}. severity_identifier uses ImpactSeverity enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, LOW=1, MEDIUM=2, HIGH=3, OTHER=99.

Is Own Anchor.description: A flag indicating if the element is its own anchor or is anchored to a different element.

Journal Entry.description: A text entry into a journal.

Label.description: A label used to identify or categorise a relationship link.

Last Modified Time.description: The time at which an element  was last modified.

Legal.description: Copyright and/or license information for the element or associated resource.

Liabilities.description: The additional issues that need to be considered when using this pattern.

Make Anchor.description: Is the element at end2 an anchor to end1?

Membership Type.description: Name of the type of membership.

Merge Update.description: A flag indicating if the update should be a merge or replace.

Modifier Classification.description: Classification from 0438. Applied to Referenceable. Marker classification (no attributes) indicating the element is a modifier in a naming standard.

Namespace.description: The namespace that qualifies the names of elements within this asset or data structure.

Notes.description: Notes and observations about the element.

Objective.description: The intended outcome/goal of a Meeting, ToDo, or Review person action.

Obligations.description: A dictionary of property:value pairs describing obligations.

Organization Reference.description: An organization element that, for instance, can represent a regulatory organization.

Parent at End1.description: A flag indicating if the parent is at end1 of the relationship

Parent Relationship Attributes.description: A dictionary of relationship attributes to establish the parent relationship.

Policy Management Point.description: Combined classification from 0435. Applied to Referenceable. Structure: {point_type: str, name: str, description: str}. point_type is one of: PolicyAdministrationPoint, PolicyDecisionPoint, PolicyEnforcementPoint, PolicyInformationPoint, PolicyRetrievalPoint. A Referenceable may have multiple policy management point classifications simultaneously.

Prime Word Classification.description: Classification from 0438. Applied to Referenceable. Marker classification (no attributes) indicating the element is a prime word in a naming standard.

Problem Example.description: One or more examples of the problem and its consequences.

Problem Statement.description: Description of the types of problem that this design pattern provides a solution to.

Protocol.description: Name of the protocol used for interaction.

Purpose.description: The purpose of this collection — a short description of why it exists or what it is used for.

Purposes.description: A list of purposes for this project (array<string>). Note: distinct from Collection.purpose (string, singular) which is a separate attribute on Collection Base.

Qualified Name.description: The unique, text name of an element.

Question Name.description: Qualified name of the Question (a GlossaryTerm with IsQuestion classification).

Request ID.description: A user provided or system generated request id for a conversation.

Requested Start Time.description: Requested start date/time for a Meeting, ToDo, or Review person action.

Resource Description.description: Description of the resource or how it is being used. From the ResourceList relationship (0019).

Resource Id.description: The unique identifier (qualified name or GUID) of the supporting resource in a ResourceList relationship.

Resource Properties.description: Additional properties needed to use the resource. From the ResourceList relationship (0019).

Resource Use.description: Describes how the resource is being used. From the ResourceList relationship (0019).

Resource Use Description.description: Describes how the resource is being used. From the ResourceList relationship (0019).

Restrictions.description: A dictionary of property:value pairs describing restrictions.

Retention Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, basis_identifier: int, associated_guid: str, archive_after: date, delete_after: date}. basis_identifier uses RetentionBasis enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, TEMPORARY=1, PROJECT_LIFETIME=2, TEAM_LIFETIME=3, CONTRACT_LIFETIME=4, REGULATED_LIFETIME=5, TIMEBOXED_LIFETIME=6, OTHER=99.

Security Tags.description: Optional security tags for security processing.

Solution Description.description: Description of how the solution works.

Solution Example.description: Illustrations of how the solution resolves the problem examples.

Start Date.description: Date at which the license or certification takes effect.

Steward.description: The identifier of the steward responsible for the element.

Steward Property Name.description: Property name used to identify the type of the steward.

Steward Type Name.description: The type name of the steward element.

Summary.description: A short summary of the element's meaning or purpose.

Supports Policies.existing_element: Policies - Governance Principles; Governance Obligations; Governance Approaches
Supports Policies.description: The policies that this governance control supports.

Usage.description: The usage guidance for this element — how it is intended to be used in context.

Usage Measurements.description: A dictionary of property:value pairs describing usage measurements.

User Defined Content Status.description: A user defined content status = only valid if content status is OTHER.

User Defined Status.description: A user-defined status value. Only valid when the primary status is set to OTHER.

Watch Resource.description: Whether the parent entity should receive notifications about changes to this resource. From the ResourceList relationship (0019).

Zone Membership.description: Zones scope visibility of elements to different users.

Target Element.description: Qualified name of the existing element being classified or linked.

Level Identifier.description: Numeric, org-defined severity/level (0422 GovernanceClassificationBase.levelIdentifier) used by Impact, Confidence, Confidentiality, Criticality, and Retention classifications.

Confidence Level.description: Percentage confidence (0-100) that a Semantic Assignment correctly links the element to the glossary term (0370).

Retention Basis.description: Policy basis governing how long the element/resource is retained (0422 RetentionBasis enum) — confirm exact enum values against the type definition before finalizing.

Archive After.description: Date after which the retained element/resource should be archived (0422 Retention classification).

Delete After.description: Date after which the retained element/resource should be deleted (0422 Retention classification).

Owner.description: Qualified name of the actor who owns the element (0445 Ownership classification).

Owner Type Name.description: Type name of the owner element (e.g. Person, Team) for the Ownership classification (0445).

Owner Property Name.description: Name of the property on the owner element that identifies the element owner (0445 Ownership classification).

Organization.description: Qualified name of the organization that is the origin of a digital resource (0755 Digital Resource Origin).

Business Capability.description: Qualified name of the business capability that is the origin of a digital resource (0755 Digital Resource Origin).

Governance Expectations Counts.description: Map of named governance expectation counts/thresholds (0450 GovernanceExpectations classification).

Governance Measurements.description: Map of named governance measurement values (0450 GovernanceMeasurements classification).

Security Labels.description: List of security label tags applied to the element (0423 SecurityTags classification).

Security Properties.description: Map of security property name/value pairs (0423 SecurityTags classification).

Keyword.description: Text of the search keyword being attached to the element (0012 SearchKeyword).

Keyword Description.description: Description of the search keyword (0012 SearchKeyword).

Semantic Expression.description: Expression describing how the element meaning relates to the assigned glossary term (0370 SemanticAssignment).

Semantic Definition.description: Qualified name of the glossary term providing the formal semantic definition (0370 SemanticDefinition).

Resource.description: Qualified name of the resource element being linked (0019 ResourceList).

More Information Resource.description: Qualified name of the element that provides more information about the target element (0019 MoreInformation).

Peer Duplicate.description: Qualified name of the other element known to represent the same real-world thing (PeerDuplicateLink).

Consolidated Source.description: Qualified name of a source element that a ConsolidatedDuplicate-classified element was derived from (ConsolidatedDuplicateLink).

Duplicate Notes.description: Notes explaining why elements were classified or linked as duplicates.

Scope Reference.description: Qualified name of the element that defines the scope being linked (0120 ScopedBy).

Governance Status.description: Status of a governance classification assignment.

Accounting Code.description: The single accounting code for the element (0715 AccountingCodes classification).

Accounting Code List.description: List of accounting codes for the element; accountingCode holds the primary/default value if multiple codes are used (0715 AccountingCodes classification).

Accounting Code Map.description: Map of name-to-accounting-code mappings for the element (0715 AccountingCodes classification).

Classify Impact.description: Classify an existing element with the Impact classification (0422), indicating the level of impact an event/issue described by the element will have on the organization.

Reclassify Impact.description: Update the Impact classification (0422) already applied to an element.

Declassify Impact.description: Remove the Impact classification (0422) from an element.

Classify Confidence.description: Classify an existing element with the Confidence classification (0422), indicating the level of confidence in the quality/completeness of the associated data.

Reclassify Confidence.description: Update the Confidence classification (0422) already applied to an element.

Declassify Confidence.description: Remove the Confidence classification (0422) from an element.

Classify Confidentiality.description: Classify an existing element with the Confidentiality classification (0422), indicating the level of confidentiality of the associated data.

Reclassify Confidentiality.description: Update the Confidentiality classification (0422) already applied to an element.

Declassify Confidentiality.description: Remove the Confidentiality classification (0422) from an element.

Classify Criticality.description: Classify an existing element with the Criticality classification (0422), indicating how critical the element/resource is to the organization.

Reclassify Criticality.description: Update the Criticality classification (0422) already applied to an element.

Declassify Criticality.description: Remove the Criticality classification (0422) from an element.

Classify Retention.description: Classify an existing element with the Retention classification (0422), indicating the retention policy for the element/resource.

Reclassify Retention.description: Update the Retention classification (0422) already applied to an element.

Declassify Retention.description: Remove the Retention classification (0422) from an element.

Classify Ownership.description: Classify an existing element with the Ownership classification (0445), identifying the actor who owns it.

Reclassify Ownership.description: Update the Ownership classification (0445) already applied to an element.

Declassify Ownership.description: Remove the Ownership classification (0445) from an element.

Classify Digital Resource Origin.description: Classify an existing element with the Digital Resource Origin classification (0755), identifying the organization/business capability it originated from.

Reclassify Digital Resource Origin.description: Update the Digital Resource Origin classification (0755) already applied to an element.

Declassify Digital Resource Origin.description: Remove the Digital Resource Origin classification (0755) from an element.

Classify Zone Membership.description: Classify an existing element with the Zone Membership classification (0424), assigning it to one or more governance zones.

Reclassify Zone Membership.description: Update the Zone Membership classification (0424) already applied to an element.

Declassify Zone Membership.description: Remove the Zone Membership classification (0424) from an element.

Classify Data Scope.description: Classify an existing element with the Data Scope classification (0210). Property set kept generic pending confirmation of exact 0210 attribute names.

Update Data Scope.description: Update the Data Scope classification (0210) already applied to an element.

Declassify Data Scope.description: Remove the Data Scope classification (0210) from an element.

Classify Governance Expectations.description: Classify an existing element with the Governance Expectations classification (0450), recording expected governance counts/thresholds.

Update Governance Expectations.description: Update the Governance Expectations classification (0450) already applied to an element.

Declassify Governance Expectations.description: Remove the Governance Expectations classification (0450) from an element.

Classify Governance Measurements.description: Classify an existing element with the Governance Measurements classification (0450), recording actual governance measurement values.

Update Governance Measurements.description: Update the Governance Measurements classification (0450) already applied to an element.

Declassify Governance Measurements.description: Remove the Governance Measurements classification (0450) from an element.

Classify Security Tags.description: Classify an existing element with the Security Tags classification (0423), attaching security labels/properties for downstream security processing.

Reclassify Security Tags.description: Replace the Security Tags classification (0423) already applied to an element.

Declassify Security Tags.description: Remove the Security Tags classification (0423) from an element.

Classify Known Duplicate.description: Classify an element to indicate it has one or more known duplicates in the metadata ecosystem (duplicate management).

Declassify Known Duplicate.description: Remove the KnownDuplicate classification from an element.

Classify Consolidated Duplicate.description: Classify an element to indicate it is derived from one or more duplicates in the metadata ecosystem (duplicate management).

Declassify Consolidated Duplicate.description: Remove the ConsolidatedDuplicate classification from an element.

Classify Class Word.description: Classify an existing element as a class word in a naming standard (0438).

Declassify Class Word.description: Remove the ClassWord classification (0438) from an element.

Classify Modifier.description: Classify an existing element as a modifier in a naming standard (0438).

Declassify Modifier.description: Remove the Modifier classification (0438) from an element.

Classify Policy Management Point.description: Classify an existing element as a Policy Management Point (0435: PAP, PDP, PEP, PIP, or PRP).

Declassify Policy Management Point.description: Remove the Policy Management Point classification (0435) from an element.

Attach Search Keyword.description: Create a search keyword and attach it to an existing element (0012 SearchKeyword). Creates the Keyword entity and the link in one call.

Update Search Keyword.description: Update a search keyword already attached to an element (0012 SearchKeyword).

Detach Search Keyword.description: Remove a search keyword from an element (0012 SearchKeyword).

Link Semantic Assignment.description: Create a SemanticAssignment relationship (0370) between an existing element and a glossary term, indicating the data matches the term meaning.

Unlink Semantic Assignment.description: Remove a SemanticAssignment relationship (0370) between an element and a glossary term.

Link Semantic Definition.description: Create a SemanticDefinition relationship (0370) linking an element to the glossary term that formally defines it. Currently implemented via data_designer.py, not ClassificationExplorer — confirm client choice before processor wiring.

Unlink Semantic Definition.description: Remove a SemanticDefinition relationship (0370) from an element.

Link More Information.description: Create a MoreInformation relationship (0019) pointing from an element to another element that provides more information about it. Real pyegeria gap — no ClassificationExplorer method exists yet.

Unlink More Information.description: Remove a MoreInformation relationship (0019) from an element. Real pyegeria gap — no ClassificationExplorer method exists yet.

Link Resource To Element.description: Create a ResourceList relationship (0019) linking an element to a resource that supports it. Real pyegeria gap — no ClassificationExplorer method exists yet, though the Resource List attribute bundle already exists and is reused by 11 other command families.

Unlink Resource From Element.description: Remove a ResourceList relationship (0019) from an element. Real pyegeria gap — no ClassificationExplorer method exists yet.

Link Element To Scope.description: Create a ScopedBy relationship (0120) linking an element to the element that defines its scope.

Unlink Element From Scope.description: Remove a ScopedBy relationship (0120) from an element.

Link Peer Duplicate.description: Create a PeerDuplicateLink relationship between two elements that represent the same real-world thing (duplicate management).

Unlink Peer Duplicate.description: Remove a PeerDuplicateLink relationship between two elements (duplicate management).

Link Consolidated Duplicate To Source.description: Create a ConsolidatedDuplicateLink relationship from a consolidated element to one of the source elements it was derived from (duplicate management).

Unlink Consolidated Duplicate From Sourc.description: Remove a ConsolidatedDuplicateLink relationship between a consolidated element and a source element.

Classify Prime Word.description: Classify an existing element as a prime word in a naming standard (0438).

Declassify Prime Word.description: Remove the PrimeWord classification (0438) from an element.

Classify Accounting Codes.description: Classify an existing element with the Accounting Codes classification (0715), tracking financial accounting codes for the element.

Reclassify Accounting Codes.description: Replace the Accounting Codes classification (0715) already applied to an element.

Declassify Accounting Codes.description: Remove the Accounting Codes classification (0715) from an element.
